kimi_client_binary.non_kimi_effort_hint: Non-Kimi providers receive effort strings without client-side mapping; choose an effort supported by the selected model. For Kimi models, check support_efforts and default_effort. See ${THINKING_EFFORT_CONFIG_DOCS_URL}

fix_effort_source_lines: SHIM_FIX_EFFORT      if "1", rewrite JSON reasoning_effort not in {low,medium,high,xhigh} to "high"

models.cascade/glm-5.3-flash: FAST bucket, CASCADE lane: devin first (primary), zai fallback, hyper third. All legs are now tool-capable (devin speaks its native RPC through devin-shim v2), so this lane handles both text and tool subtasks.
models.zai-coding-plan/glm-5.3-flash-low: FAST bucket pinned to LOW thinking effort, zai lane. Cheapest option for trivial exploration and mechanical checks.
models.cursor/composer-2.5: VERY-FAST lane: Cursor Composer 2.5 at full capability — the model has no effort parameter, the plain slug is its maximum (the -fast slug is the trimmed one). CHAT-ONLY (no tool calls): use for text-only subtasks.
models.cursor/cursor-grok-4.5-low-fast: VERY-FAST lane: Cursor-hosted Grok 4.5, LOW reasoning + fast variant. CHAT-ONLY (no tool calls): text-only subtasks.
models.hyper/deepseek-v4.1-flash: FAST bucket, hyper lane. Cheap generalist for latency-sensitive subtasks on the alternative provider.
models.cascade/deepseek-v4.1-flash: FAST bucket, CASCADE lane (default): opencode-go first, hyper fallback, devin third on quota exhaustion. Legs 1-2 are tool-capable; leg 3 (devin) is chat-only — a tool task that cascades all the way degrades.
models.alibaba-token-plan/deepseek-v4.1-flash: FAST bucket, token-plan key 1. Cheap generalist for exploration, review, summaries.
models.alibaba-token-plan-2/deepseek-v4.1-flash: FAST bucket, token-plan key 2 — separate key/quota lane.
models.alibaba-token-plan-3/deepseek-v4.1-flash: FAST bucket, token-plan key 3 — separate key/quota lane.
models.alibaba-token-plan/qwen3.8-flash: MIDDLE bucket, token-plan key 1. For coder subagents: general implementation, refactors, and code-change subtasks.
models.alibaba-token-plan-2/qwen3.8-flash: MIDDLE bucket, token-plan key 2 — separate key/quota lane.
models.alibaba-token-plan-3/qwen3.8-flash: MIDDLE bucket, token-plan key 3 — separate key/quota lane.
models.zai-coding-plan/glm-5-turbo: MIDDLE bucket, zai coding-plan lane (200k context). Faster-than-strong option for everyday implementation subtasks.
models.hyper/qwen3.8-flash: MIDDLE bucket, hyper lane. General implementation on the alternative provider.
models.openai-codex/gpt-6.1-sol: STRONG bucket, codex lane (ChatGPT plan). Flagship coding model, 500k context, efforts low→max.
models.xai-oauth/grok-4.5: MIDDLE bucket, xai lane. 500k context, image_in.
models.openai-codex/gpt-6.1-sol-high: STRONG bucket pinned to HIGH effort (cheaper than max), codex lane. Everyday hard subtasks: implementation, deep debugging, reviews.
